messages:
Alex: starting thread: design + rollout notes for converting runtime mode-shim into a library + CLI migrator. need quick feedback on compat guarantees and ops runbook. :wave:
Priya: high level first: are we keeping wire-level compatibility for Hosted <-> Dedicated requests or only SDK/agent?
Alex: aim is wire-compatible for 99% of requests. translation lib will accept existing HTTP headers and payloads and synthesize any shim-only metadata. SDKs will get helper wrappers but are optional.
Mark: a few red flags: 1) KV cache binary layout differences 2) real-time streaming semantics 3) per-tenant rate-limits embedded in shim. how are those handled?
Alex: KV layout: lib will negotiate `kvcache_v` via handshake header and fall back to read-only if mismatch. Streaming: lib implements chunked semantics and has a stream-proxy shim we include for Dedicated to avoid client changes. Rate-limits: control plane will continue enforcing per-tenant limits; migrator will patch local config where permitted.
Jen: Private installs: we can't push CLI to air-gapped systems. customers will run migrator locally. need docs + attestation artifact so they can trust behavior.
Alex: agreed. migrator produces a signed digest + pull request-style patch they can inspect. will publish verification steps. also plan offline checksum verifier for air-gapped installs.
Owen: monitoring concern: removing shim might change how request timing is recorded. Billing relies on token/time attribution. how preserve?
Alex: lib will emit a stable header `X-Redwood-Compat` with fields: `shim_version`, `translated=true|false`, `latency_source=lib|shim`. tracing adaptor duplicates shim metrics names so billing queries continue to work.
Priya: test matrix needed ASAP. minimal set: hosted internal canary, hosted public dry-run, dedicated opt-in canary, private opt-in assisted. split tests for streaming vs non-streaming, kv-upgrade and auth-handshake.
Alex: drafting matrix. draft rows: mode, traffic %, duration, rollback trigger, telemetry checks. will share shortly.
Mark: rollback semantics need to be very simple. ops wants one-liner to revert and one-liner to enable fallback circuit.
Alex: agreed. CLI commands: `redwood-migrator apply --canary --ts <ts>` and `redwood-migrator rollback --canary --ts <ts>`; fallback circuit: `redwood-migrator set-fallback --policy circuit-open-after=5`. will include examples.
Jen: security: ensure migrator never logs secrets and that audit events exclude PII. Also require signed attestations for any HSM key-wrap tests.
Alex: policy: no-secret-logs enforced by linter. migrator has a `--scrub-logs` option. HSM flows require `--hsm-probe` and produce an attestation signed by our key.
Owen: capacity & autoscale: recommend a short buffer window for dedicated nodes during canary (30m warmup + 15% extra capacity). Also set p99 latency alert at +25% of baseline.
Alex: noted. will coordinate with infra to reserve burst. ops-bot: please schedule a 24h capacity buffer for canary cluster infra-009.
ops-bot: scheduled: reserve 15% extra capacity on infra-009 from 2025-02-15T10:00Z -> 2025-02-16T10:00Z. ticket #OPS-4912.
Priya: can we add a metric flag in traces so we can filter migrated vs non-migrated traffic in dashboards?
Alex: yes: `compat.migration_stage=none|dry_run|applied` and `compat.lib_version=...`. we'll add filters in the console.
Mark: remind me about function/tool calling and structured outputs — translation mustn't break function invocation semantics.
Alex: lib preserves function call markers and will forward tool-calling metadata verbatim. tests will include tool mocks.
Jen: docs owners: assign me + Priya for migration docs, Mark for tests, Owen for capacity plan, Alex for the migrator code + release notes.
Alex: thanks. timeline suggestion: week0 publish RFC + compat matrix, week1 internal hosted canary dry-run, week2 hosted public dry-run, week3 dedicated opt-ins, week5 dedicated canaries, week7 private manual migrations, week10 deprecation + 30d fallback period.
Priya: sounds reasonable. ensure legal/compliance signoff for private attestations before week7.
Alex: will loop in legal. small sample migrator config: ```yaml
mode: dry-run
compat_probe:
  stream_check: true
  kvcache_probe: true
  hsm_probe: optional
fallback:
  policy: circuit-open-after-5
  throttle: p95 > 400ms
```
Owen: put health-check endpoints behind the migrator so we can safely probe without affecting production metrics.
Alex: good idea — migrator exposes `/migrator/health` and `/migrator/probe` endpoints. will add auth token requirement.
Jen: one more thing: create an audit event `migration.run` with fields: `actor`, `target`, `config_hash`, `result`. private customers need the artifact to prove they ran the migrator.
Alex: done — audits + signed artifact. I'll post the draft migration playbook and the test matrix in this thread by EOD and tag owners. thanks all. :white_check_mark:
